invented.quote: With the bridge and the lower spending, we have cash into autumn 2027 before counting any revenue. That takes us through the 2027 pollination season, when most of our revenue comes in.
invented.why: The brief does not state the current year, and even with the $600,000 bridge added to the $340,000 balance, burning $95,000 a month until February and $75,000 a month thereafter only provides about a year of cash runway without revenue, not until autumn 2027.
